skills.body: --- name: api-gateway-proxy-expert description: "API gateways, reverse proxies, and service mesh (Kong, Traefik, NGINX) / API gateway, reverse proxy, dan service mesh (Kong, Traefik, NGINX)." author: "Roedy Rustam" version: "4.8.0" --- # API Gateway, Reverse Proxy & Service Perimeter Expert (2026 Edition) [English](#english) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#bahasa-indonesia) --- ## English ### Orchestration & Integration - **Upstream Specs & Routing**: `api-design-expert`, `openapi-swagger-codegen-expert`, `spec-driven-development-expert` - **Backend Upstreams**: `js-backend-expert`, `python-programming-expert`, `go-programming-expert`, `rust-programming-expert` - **Streaming & Realtime**: `sse-websocket-streaming-expert`, `voice-ai-realtime-agent` - **Security & Perimeter**: `rate-limit-abuse-prevention`, `zero-trust-secret-vault`, `autonomous-red-teamer` - **DevOps & Orchestration**: `ci-cd-devops-architect`, `docker-container-expert`, `zero-to-prod-orchestrator` ### Description Production architectural guide for API Gateways, Edge Proxies, and perimeter traffic management in modern microservices and serverless topologies. Covers zero-downtime routing, SSL/TLS termination, automatic certificate issuance (Let's Encrypt), rate limiting at L7, Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket connection proxying, canary traffic splitting, and configuration templates for Caddy, Traefik, and NGINX. ### Trigger Conditions - Architecting a unified API entry point (Backend-for-Frontend / BFF) in front of multiple microservices. - Configuring reverse proxies for SSE, WebSockets, or streaming AI model outputs without proxy buffer truncation. - Implementing edge-level DDoS mitigation, IP allowlisting, or API key validation. - Configuring automatic SSL/TLS termination with modern HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 (QUIC) support. ### Level 1: Production Caddyfile (Automatic TLS + WebSocket/SSE Proxying) ```caddyfile # /etc/caddy/Caddyfile api.vibesplug.internal { # Modern TLS 1.3 enforcement tls admin@vibesplug.internal # Global compression encode zstd gzip # Security Headers header { Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload" X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" X-Frame-Options "DENY" Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" } # Route 1: Auth Service (Rate limited) handle /v1/auth/* { reverse_proxy localhost:4001 { header_up X-Real-IP {remote_host} header_up X-Forwarded-Proto {scheme} } } # Route 2: Streaming Real-time SSE / WebSockets (Buffer disabled) handle /v1/ai/stream* { reverse_proxy localhost:4002 { flush_interval -1 header_up Connection "upgrade" header_up Upgrade {http.request.header.Upgrade} } } # Route 3: Default Core Microservice Pool (Round-Robin Load Balanced) handle /v1/* { reverse_proxy localhost:5001 localhost:5002 { lb_policy round_robin lb_try_duration 2s fail_duration 10s max_fails 3 } } } ``` ### Level 2: High-Performance NGINX Reverse Proxy for AI Streaming & SSE ```nginx # /etc/nginx/conf.d/api_gateway.conf upstream backend_nodes { server 127.0.0.1:3001 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s; server 127.0.0.1:3002 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s; keepalive 64; } server { listen 443 ssl http2; server_name api.vibesplug.internal; ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/bundle.crt; ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/private/privkey.key; ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; # Crucial for SSE & LLM Streaming: disable proxy buffering and set long timeouts location /v1/stream { proxy_pass http://backend_nodes; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme; proxy_buffering off; proxy_cache off; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_read_timeout 600s; proxy_send_timeout 600s; } } ``` ### Level 3: Trusted Proxy Hop Extractor & `X-Forwarded-For` Anti-Spoofing Guard (TypeScript) Never blindly read `req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]`, which an attacker can trivially spoof to bypass IP rate limits. Traverse right-to-left skipping only trusted proxy CIDR hops: ```typescript // src/lib/gateway/trusted-client-ip.ts export function extractTrustedClientIp( xForwardedForHeader: string | null | undefined, directSocketIp: string, trustedProxyIps: ReadonlySet ): string { if (!trustedProxyIps.has(directSocketIp) || !xForwardedForHeader) { return directSocketIp; } const hops = xForwardedForHeader .split(',') .map((ip) => ip.trim()) .filter((ip) => ip.length > 0); for (let i = hops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const candidateIp = hops[i]; if (!trustedProxyIps.has(candidateIp)) { return candidateIp; } } return hops[0] || directSocketIp; } ``` ### Level 4: Declarative Kong Gateway 3.8 L7 Canary & Circuit-Breaker Config (`kong.yaml`) Use db-less declarative configuration (`_format_version: "3.0"`) for GitOps-verified L7 rate limiting, canary traffic splitting, and upstream health checks: ```yaml # kong.yaml _format_version: "3.0" _transform: true upstreams: - name: core-api-upstream algorithm: consistent-hashing hash_on: header hash_on_header: x-tenant-id healthchecks: active: http_path: /healthz healthy: interval: 5 successes: 2 unhealthy: interval: 5 http_failures: 3 timeouts: 2 targets: - target: api-stable.internal:3000 weight: 90 - target: api-canary.internal:3000 weight: 10 services: - name: core-api-service host: core-api-upstream port: 3000 protocol: http connect_timeout: 3000 read_timeout: 60000 write_timeout: 60000 routes: - name: v1-api-route paths: - /v1 strip_path: false protocols: - https plugins: - name: rate-limiting config: minute: 300 policy: redis hide_client_headers: false - name: correlation-id config: header_name: x-request-id generator: uuid#counter echo_downstream: true ``` ### Key Perimeter Architectural Rules 1. **Always Set `proxy_buffering off` for Streaming**: If proxy buffering is enabled, LLM tokens and Server-Sent Events will be delayed and batched until the buffer fills (~4KB-16KB), destroying the perceived TTFT. 2. **Forwarded Header Sanitation**: Strip spoofed incoming `X-Forwarded-For` headers from untrusted clients to prevent security bypasses in IP-based rate limiters. 3. **Health Check Probes**: Always configure active health checks so the proxy immediately drops unhealthy microservice pods without returning 502 Bad Gateway to users. 4. **Enforce Strict TLS 1.2/1.3 & HSTS**: Reject legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 handshakes at the edge and emit `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload`. 5. **Bounded Upstream Timeouts & Circuit Breaking**: Configure explicit `connect_timeout` (`<= 3s`) and `max_fails` circuit breakers on every upstream pool to prevent slowloris and thread-pool exhaustion. ### Sovereign Execution, Token Efficiency & Invariants | Dimension | Sovereign Mandate & Deterministic Contract | | :--- | :--- | | **Frontier Model Cascade** | Medium / High (`Gemini 4 Neon`, `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `GPT-5.6 Sol Medium`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`) | | **Availability Fallback** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec api-gateway-proxy-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | P99 API Gateway Latency < 85ms, OpenAPI 3.1 / TypeSpec strict schema parity, RFC 9457 Problem Details error contracts, Idempotency-Key enforcement; 100% complete zero-placeholder output verified via `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` | --- --- ## Bahasa Indonesia ### Integrasi Orkestrasi - **Spesifikasi Hulu & Routing**: `api-design-expert`, `openapi-swagger-codegen-expert`, `spec-driven-development-expert` - **Upstream Backend**: `js-backend-expert`, `python-programming-expert`, `go-programming-expert`, `rust-programming-expert` - **Streaming & Realtime**: `sse-websocket-streaming-expert`, `voice-ai-realtime-agent` - **Keamanan & Perimeter**: `rate-limit-abuse-prevention`, `zero-trust-secret-vault`, `autonomous-red-teamer` - **DevOps & Orkestrasi**: `ci-cd-devops-architect`, `docker-container-expert`, `zero-to-prod-orchestrator` ### Deskripsi Panduan arsitektur produksi untuk API Gateway, Edge Proxy, dan manajemen trafik perimeter dalam topologi microservices dan serverless modern. Mencakup routing tanpa downtime, terminasi SSL/TLS otomatis (Let's Encrypt), rate limiting pada layer L7, proxy koneksi Server-Sent Events (SSE) dan WebSocket tanpa buffering, pemisahan trafik canary, serta template konfigurasi untuk Caddy, Traefik, dan NGINX. ### Kondisi Pemicu - Merancang pintu gerbang masuk tunggal (BFF) di depan kumpulan microservices backend. - Mengonfigurasi reverse proxy untuk streaming token AI atau SSE agar respons tidak terpotong. - Menerapkan pertahanan DDoS tingkat edge, pembatasan IP (allowlisting), atau verifikasi API key. - Menyiapkan terminasi SSL/TLS dengan protokol HTTP/2 dan HTTP/3 (QUIC). ### Contoh Konfigurasi Docker Compose dengan Traefik (Auto-Discovery) ```yaml # docker-compose.yml services: traefik: image: traefik:v3.1 command: - "--providers.docker=true" - "--entrypoints.websecure.address=:443" - "--certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.tlschallenge=true" ports: - "443:443" volumes: - "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro" api-service: image: my-company/api:v4.7.0 labels: - "traefik.enable=true" - "traefik.http.routers.api.rule=Host(`api.vibesplug.internal`)" - "traefik.http.routers.api.entrypoints=websecure" - "traefik.http.routers.api.tls.certresolver=myresolver" ``` ### 3 Praktik Wajib Proxy Streaming 1. **Matikan Buffering Proxy**: Untuk endpoint streaming AI atau Server-Sent Events, wajib matikan buffering (`proxy_buffering off` di NGINX, `flush_interval -1` di Caddy) agar token muncul seketika di layar pengguna. 2. **Atur Timeout Panjang**: Berikan batas waktu pembacaan (`proxy_read_timeout 600s`) agar koneksi streaming tidak terputus di tengah jalan saat respons AI panjang. 3. **Penyaringan Header Asli**: Teruskan `X-Real-IP` dan `X-Forwarded-Proto` agar backend dapat mendeteksi lokasi dan skema enkripsi klien secara akurat. ### Matriks Eksekusi Berdaulat, Efisiensi Token & Invarian | Dimensi | Mandat Berdaulat & Kontrak Deterministik | | :--- | :--- | | **Kaskade Model Frontier** | Medium / High (`Gemini 4 Neon`, `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `GPT-5.6 Sol Medium`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`) | | **Invarian Fallback Ketersediaan** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Bebas gagal saat model belum tersedia/kuota penuh) | | **Protokol Hemat Token & KV-Cache** | Kunci instruksi & skema statis di prefix awal (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); kirim potongan `CONTEXT_MAP.md` (<250 token/panggilan) saat Fan-Out | | **Eksekusi SaaT CLI & MCP** | CLI: `vibes skill exec api-gateway-proxy-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **Invarian NFR & Anti-Slop** | Latensi P99 API < 85ms, paritas skema ketat OpenAPI 3.1 / TypeSpec, kontrak error RFC 9457 Problem Details, penegakan Idempotency-Key; kode 100% tuntas tanpa placeholder diverifikasi melalui `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` |

skills.body: --- name: app-analyzer-optimizer description: "Deep application architecture audit, bottleneck detection, and perf / Audit arsitektur aplikasi mendalam, deteksi bottleneck, dan optimasi." author: "Roedy Rustam" version: "4.8.0" --- # App Analyzer & Optimizer (2026 Edition) [English](#english) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#bahasa-indonesia) --- ## English ### Orchestration & Integration - **Upstream & Lifecycle**: `zero-to-prod-orchestrator` (Phase 5 Optimization & Phase 6 QA), `brainstorming`, `session-memory-manager`. - **AST & Codebase Graph**: `living-codebase-ast-graph` (circular dependency & module size analysis), `scalability-clean-code` (code smell & God class refactoring). - **Performance & Vitals**: `performance-web-vitals` (Core Web Vitals LCP/INP profiling), `production-ready-hardener` (bundle audits & pre-flight hardening). - **Database & Backend Profiling**: `database-orm-expert` (N+1 query & index profiling), `coderabbit` (automated AI code review). - **Cross-Domain Synergy & Subagent Swarm Integration**: `zero-tech-debt-auditor`, `data-telemetry-expert` - **Evolutionary Algorithm & Kernel Discovery**: Connects to `neurosymbolic-genetic-synthesizer` for Quality-Diversity MAP-Elites synthesis and formal sandbox fitness verification. ### Description Deep application analysis and optimization skill. Performs architectural audits, bottleneck detection, bundle analysis, database query profiling, and AI-assisted code review across Next.js, React, Node.js, Go, Python, and Rust applications. ### Trigger Conditions - Auditing an existing codebase for architectural issues or technical debt. - Detecting performance bottlenecks (slow API routes, large bundles, N+1 queries). - Analyzing bundle size and suggesting code splitting opportunities. - Reviewing code quality (complexity, duplication, dead code). - Using AI-assisted tools to accelerate code review and analysis. ### Analysis Protocol (5 Phases) #### Phase 1: Architecture Discovery ```bash # Map the entire project structure find . -type f -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.go" | head -100 # Count lines per file (find largest files) find . -name "*.ts" -exec wc -l {} + | sort -rn | head -20 # Find circular dependencies (TypeScript/JS) npx madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx src/ ``` #### Phase 2: Bundle Analysis (Next.js / Vite) ```bash # Next.js bundle analyzer ANALYZE=true next build # Or install dedicated tool npx @next/bundle-analyzer # Vite bundle visualization npx vite-bundle-visualizer # Check for duplicate dependencies npx depcheck npx bundle-phobia-cli check package.json ``` Key bundle red flags: - Any single chunk > 500KB (uncompressed). - Importing entire libraries (`import _ from 'lodash'` vs `import debounce from 'lodash/debounce'`). - Moment.js (replace with `date-fns` or `Temporal`). - `node_modules` leaking into client bundle. #### Phase 3: Database Query Analysis ```sql -- PostgreSQL: Find slow queries SELECT query, mean_exec_time, calls, total_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20; -- Find missing indexes (sequential scans on large tables) SELECT schemaname, tablename, attname, n_distinct, correlation FROM pg_stats WHERE tablename = 'your_table' ORDER BY n_distinct DESC; -- Detect N+1 queries: Enable query logging -- In Drizzle: const db = drizzle(client, { logger: true }); -- In Prisma: DATABASE_URL="...?connection_limit=5" prisma studio ``` #### Phase 4: AI-Assisted Code Review Use AI tools to accelerate analysis: | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | **CodeRabbit** | Automated PR review, pattern detection | | **Sourcegraph Cody** | Codebase-wide semantic search and explanation | | **GitHub Copilot** | Inline suggestions and refactoring | | **Cursor / Windsurf** | AI IDE with full-repo context | AI review prompts for Gemini Agent: ``` Analyze all files in src/features/ and identify: 1. Functions longer than 30 lines 2. Duplicated business logic across files 3. Missing error handling in async functions 4. Components that directly call APIs (violating separation of concerns) ``` #### Phase 5: Performance Profiling **Frontend (React / Next.js):** ```bash # React DevTools Profiler — identify render bottlenecks # Chrome DevTools > Performance tab > Record interaction # Lighthouse CI — automated CWV tracking npm install -g @lhci/cli lhci autorun ``` **Backend (Node.js):** ```bash # Built-in Node.js profiler node --prof server.js node --prof-process isolate-*.log > processed.txt # Clinic.js — flamegraph, bubble chart, doctor npm install -g clinic clinic doctor -- node server.js clinic flame -- node server.js ``` **Go:** ```bash # Built-in pprof profiler go tool pprof http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 go tool pprof -http=:8080 profile.out ``` ### Common Bottleneck Patterns & Fixes | Bottleneck | Symptom | Fix | |---|---|---| | N+1 queries | DB calls proportional to list length | Add `.include()` / JOIN or DataLoader | | Missing indexes | Slow queries on filtered columns | `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` | | Unoptimized images | Large LCP, slow page load | Next.js ``, WebP, lazy loading | | Over-fetching | Fetching full objects when only 1 field needed | Select specific columns | | No pagination | Fetching entire tables | Add `LIMIT/OFFSET` or cursor pagination | | Blocking main thread | High INP, unresponsive UI | `useTransition`, web workers | | No caching | Same data fetched repeatedly | Redis, React Query staleTime, HTTP cache | | Bundle bloat | Large JS payload | Tree-shaking, code splitting, lazy imports | ### Hard Guardrails (Declarative Invariants) 1. **Dynamic Imports on Heavy Client Dependencies**: - Client-side libraries exceeding 50KB gzipped (data visualization, syntax highlighters, PDF generators) MUST use dynamic imports (`next/dynamic` or `React.lazy`) with SSR disablement where applicable. Synchronous top-level imports that bloat initial bundles are prohibited. 2. **Deterministic Tree-Shaking & Dead Code Elimination**: - Codebases MUST ban wildcard namespace imports (`import * as ...`) for large utility libraries. Circular imports detected via `madge` and unreferenced exported symbols MUST be resolved prior to release. 3. **Evidence-Based Database Optimization**: - Database performance recommendations MUST provide `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` evidence demonstrating sequential scan elimination or buffer reduction before adding indexes. Speculative untracked indexing is forbidden. 4. **Core Web Vitals Budget Adherence**: - Client bundle initial JS payload MUST remain under 150KB gzipped, and LCP under 1.8s. Uncompressed static asset delivery in production deployments is strictly prohibited. ### Sovereign Execution, Token Efficiency & Invariants | Dimension | Sovereign Mandate & Deterministic Contract | | :--- | :--- | | **Frontier Model Cascade** | High Fast / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Gemini 4 Pro`) | | **Availability Fallback** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6`; `Grok 4.7` -> `Grok 4.6 High Fast` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec app-analyzer-optimizer ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | JS initial client bundle < 150KB gzipped, 0 duplicate dependency versions, Core Web Vitals all-green (LCP < 1.8s, INP < 100ms); 100% complete zero-placeholder output verified via `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` | --- --- ## Bahasa Indonesia ### Integrasi Orkestrasi - **Hulu & Siklus Hidup**: `zero-to-prod-orchestrator` (Optimasi Fase 5 & QA Fase 6), `brainstorming`, `session-memory-manager`. - **AST & Graf Basis Kode**: `living-codebase-ast-graph` (dependensi sirkular & analisis ukuran modul), `scalability-clean-code` (refaktor code smell & God class). - **Performa & Web Vitals**: `performance-web-vitals` (profiling Core Web Vitals LCP/INP), `production-ready-hardener` (audit bundle & pengerasan pra-rilis). - **Profiling Database & Backend**: `database-orm-expert` (query N+1 & profiling indeks), `coderabbit` (code review AI otomatis). - **Sinergi Lintas Domain & Integrasi Swarm Subagent**: `zero-tech-debt-auditor`, `data-telemetry-expert` ### Deskripsi Skill analisis dan optimasi aplikasi mendalam. Melakukan audit arsitektur, deteksi bottleneck, analisis bundle, profiling query database, dan code review berbantuan AI di aplikasi Next.js, React, Node.js, Go, Python, dan Rust. ### Kondisi Pemicu - Mengaudit codebase yang ada untuk masalah arsitektur atau hutang teknis. - Mendeteksi bottleneck performa (rute API lambat, bundle besar, query N+1). - Menganalisis ukuran bundle dan menyarankan peluang code splitting. - Meninjau kualitas kode (kompleksitas, duplikasi, kode mati). - Menggunakan tool berbantuan AI untuk mempercepat code review dan analisis. ### Protokol Analisis (5 Fase) #### Fase 1: Penemuan Arsitektur Petakan seluruh struktur proyek, hitung baris per file untuk menemukan file terbesar, dan deteksi dependensi circular dengan `npx madge --circular`. #### Fase 2: Analisis Bundle (Next.js / Vite) Gunakan `ANALYZE=true next build` atau `npx vite-bundle-visualizer`. Tanda bahaya bundle: chunk tunggal > 500KB, mengimpor library penuh, Moment.js, atau `node_modules` yang bocor ke bundle klien. #### Fase 3: Analisis Query Database Gunakan `pg_stat_statements` untuk menemukan query lambat. Cari scan sequential pada tabel besar (tanda indeks yang hilang). Aktifkan logging query di Drizzle/Prisma untuk mendeteksi pola N+1. #### Fase 4: Code Review Berbantuan AI Gunakan CodeRabbit untuk review PR otomatis, Sourcegraph Cody untuk pencarian semantik seluruh codebase, dan Gemini Agent dengan prompt analisis spesifik untuk menemukan fungsi panjang, logika bisnis yang diduplikasi, dan error handling yang hilang. #### Fase 5: Profiling Performa - **Frontend**: React DevTools Profiler, Lighthouse CI. - **Backend Node.js**: `node --prof`, Clinic.js untuk flamegraph. - **Go**: `go tool pprof` untuk CPU dan memory profiling. ### Pola Bottleneck Umum & Perbaikan | Bottleneck | Gejala | Perbaikan | |---|---|---| | Query N+1 | Panggilan DB proporsional dengan panjang daftar | Tambahkan `.include()` / JOIN atau DataLoader | | Indeks yang hilang | Query lambat pada kolom yang difilter | `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` | | Gambar tidak dioptimalkan | LCP besar, halaman lambat | Next.js ``, WebP, lazy loading | | Over-fetching | Mengambil objek penuh saat hanya 1 field dibutuhkan | Pilih kolom spesifik | | Tanpa paginasi | Mengambil seluruh tabel | Tambahkan `LIMIT/OFFSET` atau cursor pagination | | Memblokir thread utama | INP tinggi, UI tidak responsif | `useTransition`, web workers | | Tanpa caching | Data yang sama diambil berulang kali | Redis, React Query staleTime, HTTP cache | | Bundle membengkak | Payload JS besar | Tree-shaking, code splitting, lazy imports | ### Matriks Eksekusi Berdaulat, Efisiensi Token & Invarian | Dimensi | Mandat Berdaulat & Kontrak Deterministik | | :--- | :--- | | **Kaskade Model Frontier** | High Fast / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Gemini 4 Pro`) | | **Invarian Fallback Ketersediaan** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6`; `Grok 4.7` -> `Grok 4.6 High Fast` (Bebas gagal saat model belum tersedia/kuota penuh) | | **Protokol Hemat Token & KV-Cache** | Kunci instruksi & skema statis di prefix awal (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); kirim potongan `CONTEXT_MAP.md` (<250 token/panggilan) saat Fan-Out | | **Eksekusi SaaT CLI & MCP** | CLI: `vibes skill exec app-analyzer-optimizer ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **Invarian NFR & Anti-Slop** | Payload awal bundle JS klien < 150KB gzipped, 0 duplikasi versi dependensi, Core Web Vitals hijau semua (LCP < 1.8s, INP < 100ms); --- name: astro-framework-expert description: "Astro 7+ (latest) framework: Live Content Collections, Islands, Fonts API, and View Transitions / Framework Astro 7+ (terbaru): Live Content Collections, Islands, Fonts API, dan View Transitions." author: "Roedy Rustam" version: "4.8.0" --- # Astro 7+ (Latest) Framework Expert (2026 Edition) [English](#english) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#bahasa-indonesia) --- ## English ### Orchestration & Integration - **`modern-web-guidance`**: HTML5/CSS standards, modern browser APIs, and accessibility guidelines. - **`modern-css-native-expert`**: Native CSS anchor positioning, View Transitions Level 2, and container queries. - **`tailwind-expert`**: Tailwind CSS v4 integration with Astro. - **`ui-ux-pro-max`**: Design intelligence, editorial typography, and multi-framework component layout tokens. - **`visual-ui-auditor`**: Multimodal vision auditing of rendered Astro content and Islands. - **`anti-slop`**: Enforces complete, stub-free template code and eliminates generic landing page slop. - **`seo`**: Astro's built-in SEO capabilities, sitemaps, and structured data. - **`performance-web-vitals`**: Astro's zero-JS-by-default performance optimization. - **`headless-cms-expert`**: Content fetching from Sanity/Payload/Strapi in Astro. - **`ci-cd-devops-architect`**: Deploying Astro to Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, or Netlify. - **Cross-Domain Synergy & Subagent Swarm Integration**: `senior-frontend`, `svelte-sveltekit-expert`, `vue-frontend-expert`, `solidjs-expert`, `mpa-orchestrator`, `documentation-site-expert` ### Description Expert guide for building high-performance, content-first websites with Astro 7+. Covers Content Collections (type-safe content), Islands Architecture (partial hydration), View Transitions, server-side rendering, hybrid rendering, MDX integration, Astro DB, and multi-framework component support (React, Vue, Svelte in one project). ### Trigger Conditions - Building content-heavy websites (blogs, docs, marketing pages, portfolios). - Choosing between Astro and Next.js for a content-first project. - Implementing partial hydration or Islands Architecture. - Creating documentation sites or landing pages optimized for performance. - Using multiple UI frameworks (React + Vue + Svelte) in one project. --- ### Mandatory Scaffolding & Latest Version Protocol Always initialize new Astro projects with the latest stable release (Astro 7+ / 6+ with Vite Environment API, Live Content Collections, built-in Fonts API, and CSP support): ```bash npm create astro@latest my-astro-app # Upgrade existing project to latest: npx @astrojs/upgrade ``` ### Core Concepts #### Astro vs Next.js Decision Guide | Criteria | Astro 7+ | Next.js 16 | |----------|---------|------------| | Primary Focus | Content sites | Full-stack apps | | Default JS Shipped | 0 KB | React runtime | | Rendering | Static-first, opt-in SSR | SSR-first, opt-in static | | Multi-framework | ✅ React, Vue, Svelte, Solid | React only | | Content Collections | ✅ Built-in, type-safe | Manual with MDX | | Server Islands | ✅ Deferred rendering | PPR (similar) | | **Choose When** | Content, SEO, speed critical | Complex interactivity | **Recommendation:** Choose **Astro** for content-driven sites where performance and SEO are top priorities. Choose **Next.js** for interactive web applications with complex state. #### 1. Project Setup ```bash # Create new Astro project npm create astro@latest ./my-site -- --template blog --typescript strict # Add integrations npx astro add tailwind react mdx sitemap ``` #### 2. Content Collections (Type-Safe Content) ```typescript // src/content/config.ts import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content'; const blog = defineCollection({ type: 'content', // Markdown/MDX files schema: z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string(), pubDate: z.coerce.date(), heroImage: z.string().optional(), tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]), draft: z.boolean().default(false), }), }); const authors = defineCollection({ type: 'data', // JSON/YAML files schema: z.object({ name: z.string(), avatar: z.string(), bio: z.string(), }), }); export const collections = { blog, authors }; ``` ```astro --- // src/pages/blog/[...slug].astro import { getCollection } from 'astro:content'; export async function getStaticPaths() { const posts = await getCollection('blog', ({ data }) => !data.draft); return posts.map((post) => ({ params: { slug: post.slug }, props: { post }, })); } const { post } = Astro.props; const { Content } = await post.render(); ---

{post.data.title}

{post.data.pubDate.toLocaleDateString()}
``` #### 3. Islands Architecture (Partial Hydration) ```astro --- // Only hydrate interactive components — rest ships as 0 JS import Newsletter from '../components/Newsletter.tsx'; import Counter from '../components/Counter.vue'; import Chart from '../components/Chart.svelte'; ---

My Blog Post

This is static HTML with zero JavaScript.

``` #### 4. View Transitions ```astro --- // src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro import { ViewTransitions } from 'astro:transitions'; ---
``` #### 5. Server Islands (Deferred Rendering) ```astro --- // Renders on the server, deferred from the initial page load // Great for personalized content in otherwise static pages ---

Loading...

 ``` #### 6. Astro 7+ `ClientRouter` Parallel Curtain Transition Adapter (`src/engine/astro.ts`) When pairing Astro's `` with a GSAP + Lenis + OGL motion engine, override `event.loader` inside `astro:before-preparation` so the exit animation (`leave()`) and network fetch (`originalLoader()`) execute **in parallel** via `Promise.all`, while persistent chrome (`#gl`, `#curtain`, `#cursor`) uses `transition:persist`: ```typescript // src/engine/astro.ts — Parallel Leave + Network Fetch for Astro ClientRouter import { boot, leave, cleanup, enter } from './index'; let initialized = false; export function mountAstroEngine(): void { if (typeof window === 'undefined' || initialized) return; initialized = true; void boot(); document.addEventListener('astro:before-preparation', (event: any) => { const originalLoader = event.loader; event.loader = async () => { await Promise.all([leave(), originalLoader()]); }; }); document.addEventListener('astro:before-swap', () => { cleanup(); }); document.addEventListener('astro:after-swap', () => { enter({ transition: true, scrollTop: true }); }); } ``` #### 7. Astro 7+ Content Layer API with Custom Data Loader (`src/content.config.ts`) ```typescript // src/content.config.ts — Astro 7+ Content Layer API with loader & Zod validation import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content'; export const collections = { docs: defineCollection({ loader: async () => { // Astro 7+ supports custom remote/in-memory data loaders returning structured objects return [ { id: 'architecture-overview', title: 'System Architecture Overview', description: 'High-level architectural blueprint and swarm topology.', version: '2026.4', publishedAt: new Date('2026-03-15'), }, { id: 'zero-trust-security', title: 'Zero-Trust Security & Post-Quantum Invariants', description: 'Cryptographic attestation and boundary defense.', version: '2026.4', publishedAt: new Date('2026-04-01'), }, ]; }, schema: z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string(), description: z.string(), version: z.string(), publishedAt: z.coerce.date(), }), }), }; ``` ### Hard Guardrails (Declarative Invariants) 1. **Zero Unnecessary Client Hydration (`client:*`) Directives**: - Deliver 0 KB JavaScript by default. Interactive client directives (`client:load`, `client:visible`, `client:idle`) MUST only be placed on genuinely dynamic components (e.g. interactive filters, mobile menus). Never hydrate static text or layout wrappers. 2. **Strict Zod Schema Enforcement on All Collections**: - Every collection defined in `src/content.config.ts` MUST declare a strict `schema` object validated with Zod. Never allow untyped or loose frontmatter. 3. **Mandatory Tabular Numerals**: - Timestamps, reading times, version numbers, and metric counts rendered in Astro templates MUST declare `tabular-nums`. ### Production Checklist - [ ] Content Collections with strict Zod schemas. - [ ] Sitemap integration enabled (`@astrojs/sitemap`). - [ ] Image optimization with `astro:assets`. - [ ] View Transitions for smooth page navigation. - [ ] Hybrid rendering (static + SSR where needed). - [ ] Deploy adapter configured (Vercel, Cloudflare, Node). ### Blue-Ocean Synergy & Anti-Commodity Protocol - **Mandatory Blue-Ocean Pairing**: Always compose `astro-framework-expert` with `ephemeral-generative-ui-architect`, `visual-ui-auditor`, `multimodal-spatial-video-cloner`, `anti-slop` so commodity boilerplate is elevated into verified, self-healing production architecture. - **Anti-Commodity Mandate**: Reject generic AI UI templates: enforce 5-state interactive contracts, `tabular-nums`, crisp 1px borders, and multimodal `vibes visual-audit` verification before disk write. - **Pre-Disk Gate**: Run `vibes verify-gate` and `vibes skill auto-diff --json` to inject <350-token slices and eliminate placeholder slop. ### Sovereign Execution, Token Efficiency & Invariants | Dimension | Sovereign Mandate & Deterministic Contract | | :--- | :--- | | **Frontier Model Cascade** | High Fast / Medium / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Muse Wonder High`, `Composer 2.5 Fast`) | | **Availability Fallback** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec astro-framework-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_visual_audit`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | LCP < 1.8s, INP < 100ms, CLS < 0.05, 1px crisp borders, 3-tier radius (6px/8px/12px), `tabular-nums`, 5-state interactive contract; 100% complete zero-placeholder output verified via `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` | --- --- ## Bahasa Indonesia ### Integrasi Orkestrasi - **`modern-web-guidance`**: Standar HTML5/CSS, API browser modern, dan pedoman aksesibilitas. - **`modern-css-native-expert`**: CSS anchor positioning native, View Transitions Level 2, dan container queries. - **`tailwind-expert`**: Integrasi Tailwind CSS v4 (@theme) dengan Astro. - **`ui-ux-pro-max`**: Kecerdasan desain UI/UX, tipografi editorial, dan token layout multi-framework. - **`visual-ui-auditor`**: Audit visual multimodal untuk halaman konten dan Island Astro yang dirender. - **`anti-slop`**: Penegakan kode template lengkap tanpa stub dan membasmi slop landing page generik. - **`seo`**: Kemampuan SEO bawaan Astro, sitemap otomatis, dan data terstruktur JSON-LD. - **`performance-web-vitals`**: Optimasi performa zero-JS-by-default Astro untuk Core Web Vitals (skor 100). - **`headless-cms-expert`**: Pengambilan konten dari Sanity, Payload, atau Strapi secara type-safe di Astro. - **`ci-cd-devops-architect`**: Deployment ke Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, atau Node.js distroless container. - **Sinergi Lintas Domain & Integrasi Swarm Subagent**: `senior-frontend`, `svelte-sveltekit-expert`, `vue-frontend-expert`, `solidjs-expert`, `mpa-orchestrator`, `documentation-site-expert` ### Deskripsi Panduan tingkat produksi untuk membangun website berperforma tinggi dan berfokus konten dengan Astro 7+. Mencakup Content Collections (manajemen konten type-safe berbasis Zod), Islands Architecture (hidrasi parsial), View Transitions native, rendering hybrid/SSR, integrasi MDX, Server Islands (rendering tunda), dan orkestrasi multi-framework (React, Vue, Svelte dalam satu proyek). ### Kondisi Pemicu - Membangun situs web kaya konten (blog, dokumentasi teknis, portal berita, landing page). - Memilih arsitektur rendering antara Astro dan Next.js untuk proyek konten. - Mengimplementasikan hidrasi parsial (*Islands Architecture*) untuk memangkas bundle JavaScript ke browser. - Menambahkan Server Islands untuk komponen personalisasi tanpa mengorbankan cache CDN statis. --- ### Panduan Keputusan: Astro 7+ vs Next.js 16 | Kriteria | Astro 7+ | Next.js 16 | |---|---|---| | Fokus Utama | Situs berbasis konten | Aplikasi interaktif full-stack | | Default JavaScript Dikirim | 0 KB (Zero-JS default) | React runtime (~80 KB+) | | Model Rendering | Statis terlebih dahulu, SSR selektif | SSR-first, statis via caching | | Dukungan Multi-Framework | React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact | Hanya React | | Content Collections | Bawaan type-safe via `astro:content` | Manual via MDX / Contentlayer | | Server Islands | Rendering tunda independen (`server:defer`) | Partial Prerendering (PPR) | --- ### Implementasi Pola Kunci (2026 Standard) #### 1. Setup Proyek & Integrasi ```bash # Inisialisasi proyek Astro dengan template blog dan TypeScript ketat npm create astro@latest ./situs-astro -- --template blog --typescript strict # Menambahkan integrasi esensial secara otomatis npx astro add tailwind react mdx sitemap ``` #### 2. Content Collections Type-Safe (`astro:content`) ```typescript // src/content/config.ts import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content'; const artikel = defineCollection({ type: 'content', schema: z.object({ title: z.string().min(5), description: z.string(), publishDate: z.coerce.date(), author: z.string(), tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]), isDraft: z.boolean().default(false), }), }); const penulis = defineCollection({ type: 'data', schema: z.object({ name: z.string(), avatarUrl: z.string().url(), role: z.string(), }), }); export const collections = { artikel, penulis }; ``` ```astro --- // src/pages/artikel/[...slug].astro import { getCollection } from 'astro:content'; export async function getStaticPaths() { const posts = await getCollection('artikel', ({ data }) => !data.isDraft); return posts.map((post) => ({ params: { slug: post.slug }, props: { post }, })); } const { post } = Astro.props; const { Content } = await post.render(); ---

{post.data.title}

{post.data.publishDate.toLocaleDateString('id-ID')}
``` #### 3. Islands Architecture & Direktif Hidrasi Klien ```astro --- // src/components/HalamanInteraktif.astro import FormNewsletter from '../components/FormNewsletter.tsx'; import IndikatorMetrik from '../components/IndikatorMetrik.vue'; import MenuNavigasiMobile from '../components/MenuNavigasiMobile.svelte'; ---

Portal Teknologi

``` #### 4. View Transitions Native & Navigasi Mulus ```astro --- // src/layouts/TataLetakUtama.astro import { ViewTransitions } from 'astro:transitions'; ---
``` #### 5. Server Islands (`server:defer`) untuk Konten Dinamis ```astro --- // Renders secara asinkron di server setelah HTML statis awal dikirim via CDN import WidgetProfilPengguna from '../components/WidgetProfilPengguna.astro'; ---

Artikel Utama

Memuat data sesi pengguna...
``` #### 6. Adapter Transisi Paralel `ClientRouter` Astro 7+ (`src/engine/astro.ts`) Saat memadukan `` di Astro 7+ dengan mesin gerak GSAP + Lenis + WebGL: - Gunakan `transition:persist` dan `transition:animate="none"` pada elemen global `#gl`, `#curtain`, dan `#cursor`. - Di dalam event `astro:before-preparation`, bungkus `event.loader` dengan `await Promise.all([leave(), originalLoader()])` agar animasi tirai penutup berjalan **paralel** dengan pengunduhan HTML halaman berikutnya (tanpa jeda tunggu ganda). - Panggil `cleanup()` pada `astro:before-swap` dan `enter({ transition: true, scrollTop: true })` pada `astro:after-swap`. ### Checklist Kesiapan Produksi Astro - [ ] Validasi skema Zod ketat pada seluruh Content Collections. - [ ] Penggunaan komponen `` bawaan dari `astro:assets` untuk optimasi format WebP/AVIF. - [ ] Integrasi sitemap XML otomatis (`@astrojs/sitemap`) dan robots.txt. - [ ] Pengecekan View Transitions dengan `transition:persist` pada pemutar audio atau status navigasi. - [ ] Konfigurasi adapter deployment sesuai platform target (`@astrojs/vercel`, `@astrojs/cloudflare`, atau `@astrojs/node`). ### Sinergi Blue-Ocean & Protokol Anti-Komoditas - **Pasangan Wajib Blue-Ocean**: Selalu komposisikan `astro-framework-expert` bersama `ephemeral-generative-ui-architect`, `visual-ui-auditor`, `multimodal-spatial-video-cloner`, `anti-slop` agar boilerplate standar naik kelas menjadi arsitektur produksi terverifikasi dan *self-healing*. - **Mandat Anti-Komoditas**: Tolak UI generik: wajibkan kontrak interaktif 5-state, `tabular-nums`, border tegas 1px, serta verifikasi multimodal `vibes visual-audit` sebelum menulis ke disk. - **Gerbang Pra-Disk**: Jalankan `vibes verify-gate` dan `vibes skill auto-diff --json` untuk menyuntikkan slice <350 token serta mencegah placeholder slop. ### Matriks Eksekusi Berdaulat, Efisiensi Token & Invarian | Dimensi | Mandat Berdaulat & Kontrak Deterministik | | :--- | :--- | | **Kaskade Model Frontier** | High Fast / Medium / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Muse Wonder High`, `Composer 2.5 Fast`) | | **Invarian Fallback Ketersediaan** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Bebas gagal saat model belum tersedia/kuota penuh) | | **Protokol Hemat Token & KV-Cache** | Kunci instruksi & skema statis di prefix awal (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); kirim potongan `CONTEXT_MAP.md` (<250 token/panggilan) saat Fan-Out | | **Eksekusi SaaT CLI & MCP** | CLI: `vibes skill exec astro-framework-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_visual_audit`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **Invarian NFR & Anti-Slop** | LCP < 1.8s, INP < 100ms, CLS < 0.05, border tegas 1px, radius 3-tier (6px/8px/12px), `tabular-nums`, kontrak interaktif 5-state; kode 100% tuntas tanpa placeholder diverifikasi melalui `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` |

When invoked, the agent is mandated to execute tests, parse terminal stack traces, analyze failing assertions, and autonomously modify code in an iterative self-healing loop until all tests pass (exit code 0)—without prompting the user to manually run commands or debug errors. ### Trigger Conditions - User asks to fix failing tests or debug runtime errors without providing full error logs. - Directives such as *"Write the feature and ensure all tests pass"*, *"Fix this bug autonomously"*, or *"Refactor and verify"*. - Phase 6 (Automated Testing & Quality Gate) execution in `zero-to-prod-orchestrator`. - Post-migration regression validation in `legacy-code-translator`. ### Autonomous Self-Healing Loop (5-Step Protocol) ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 1. EXECUTE TEST RUNNER │ │ Run `vitest run`, `cargo test`, `pytest`, or `go test`│ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 2. PARSE STACK TRACE & FILTER NOISE │ │ Extract failing file, line number, expected vs actual│ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 3. AST BLAST-RADIUS CHECK │ │ Locate caller functions; isolate logic from tests │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 4. APPLY PRECISION PATCH │ │ Fix production implementation; NEVER mock fakes │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 5. RE-RUN & VERIFY (Max 5 Iterations) │ │ Exit Code 0? ──► [YES] Complete & Report Artifact │ │ └──► [NO] Loop back to Step 2 │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### Self-Healing Script Example (TypeScript / Vitest) ```typescript // scripts/tdd-runner.mjs import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; import path from 'node:path'; export function runTDDLoop(testPattern = '', maxAttempts = 5): boolean { console.log(`[TDD-Debugger] Starting autonomous test cycle (Limit: ${maxAttempts} attempts)...`); for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) { console.log(`\n--- Attempt ${attempt} of ${maxAttempts} ---`); try { const output = execSync(`npx vitest run ${testPattern} --reporter=verbose`, { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: 'pipe', }); console.log('✅ All tests passed successfully!'); return true; } catch (err: any) { const stdout = err.stdout?.toString() || ''; const stderr = err.stderr?.toString() || ''; const combined = stdout + '\n' + stderr; // Extract failing test location const frameMatch = combined.match(/(?:FAIL|Error:)\s+(.*?):(\d+):(\d+)/) || combined.match(/at\s+(.*?):(\d+):(\d+)/); if (frameMatch) { const [, file, line] = frameMatch; console.warn(`[TDD-Debugger] Failure detected at ${path.basename(file)}:${line}`); } else { console.warn('[TDD-Debugger] Test failure detected. Analyzing raw output...'); } if (attempt === maxAttempts) { console.error('❌ Reached maximum self-healing attempts. Circuit breaker tripped.'); return false; } } } return false; } ``` ### Non-Negotiable Agent Constraints 1. **Zero-Human Intervention**: NEVER ask the user *"Please run this and tell me the error"*. You possess `run_command`—execute it directly in the terminal, read stdout/stderr, and iterate until green. 2. **Respect Test Integrity (Anti-Slop Pillar 2)**: - Do NOT comment out or skip failing tests (`test.skip`) to fake a passing suite. - Do NOT replace failing assertions with trivial tautologies (`expect(true).toBe(true)`). - Fix the production source code first. Only modify test files if the test specification itself is demonstrably obsolete or contradictory. 3. **Circuit Breaker**: Capped at 5 self-healing iterations. If an issue remains unresolved after 5 cycles, pause to re-verify fundamental architectural assumptions. --- #### Stack Trace Frame Parser & Fault Localizer (TypeScript) ```typescript export interface StackFrameLocation { filePath: string; lineNumber: number; columnNumber: number; functionName: string; } export function parseTopFailingFrame(stackTrace: string): StackFrameLocation | null { const frameRegex = /ats+(?:([^s(]+)s+()?([^s():]+:d+:d+))?/; const match = stackTrace.match(frameRegex); if (!match) { return null; } const fnName = match[1] ?? 'anonymous'; const parts = match[2].split(':'); const col = Number(parts.pop()); const line = Number(parts.pop()); const filePath = parts.join(':'); return { filePath, lineNumber: line, columnNumber: col, functionName: fnName }; } ``` ### Hard Guardrails (Declarative Invariants) 1. **Strict Prohibition of Test Skipping or Tautological Assertions**: - The debugging agent MUST NOT comment out failing tests, apply `test.skip`, or alter test assertions into trivial truths (`expect(true).toBe(true)`) to fake exit code 0. Production implementation code must be fixed. 2. **Bounded Iteration Ceiling with Circuit Breaker (<= 5 Attempts)**: - The self-healing loop MUST enforce a hard maximum of 5 iterations before tripping a circuit breaker and pausing for architectural re-evaluation. 3. **Zero Request for Manual User Execution**: - The agent MUST execute test runners autonomously via terminal execution tools and parse stdout/stderr directly. Delegating test running back to the user is strictly prohibited. 4. **Strict Production Patching Without Fake Mocks**: - Fixes must patch genuine production code logic. Replacing production databases or services with hardcoded fake mocks in production code paths is forbidden. ### Sovereign Execution, Token Efficiency & Invariants | Dimension | Sovereign Mandate & Deterministic Contract | | :--- | :--- | | **Frontier Model Cascade** | High Fast / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Gemini 4 Pro`) | | **Availability Fallback** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6`; `Grok 4.7` -> `Grok 4.6 High Fast` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec autonomous-tdd-debugger ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_critic_validate`, `vibes_self_heal`, `vibes_eval_sandbox`, `vibes_verify_invariants` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | Zero OWASP Top 10 vectors, 0 hardcoded secrets, >= 90% branch coverage on domain logic, 0 Anti-Slop violations; 100% complete zero-placeholder output verified via `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` | --- --- ## Bahasa Indonesia ### Integrasi Orkestrasi - **Framework Pengujian & E2E**: `e2e-testing-expert`, `property-mutation-testing-expert`, `accessibility-testing-expert` - **Gerbang Kualitas & Anti-Slop**: `anti-slop`, `ai-code-review-autonomous`, `zero-tech-debt-auditor` - **Verifikasi Formal & Kontrak**: `formal-spec-z3-verifier`, `spec-driven-development-expert` - **Ketahanan Error & Pemulihan**: `error-resilience-expert`, `self-healing-cloud-orchestrator`, `living-codebase-ast-graph` - **Siklus Hidup & Tata Kelola**: `zero-to-prod-orchestrator`, `session-memory-manager` ### Deskripsi Mengubah agen AI dari sekadar pembuat kode pasif menjadi insinyur *Test-Driven Development* (TDD) yang aktif dan mandiri. Saat diaktifkan, agen diwajibkan menjalankan pengujian otomatis, mem-parsing *stack trace* di terminal, menganalisis kegagalan asersi, dan memodifikasi kode secara otonom dalam siklus perbaikan (*self-healing loop*) berulang hingga seluruh pengujian lulus (*exit code 0*)—tanpa meminta pengguna untuk melakukan pengujian manual. ### Kondisi Pemicu - Pengguna meminta untuk memperbaiki *test* yang gagal atau mencari *bug* tanpa menyertakan log error lengkap. - Instruksi seperti *"Tulis fitur ini dan pastikan semua test lulus"*, *"Debug kode ini secara mandiri"*, atau *"Refaktor dan buktikan dengan test"*. - Eksekusi Fase 6 (Pengujian Otomatis & Gerbang Kualitas) pada `zero-to-prod-orchestrator`. - Verifikasi regresi setelah migrasi kode warisan pada `legacy-code-translator`. ### Siklus Mandiri 5 Langkah ``` 1. JALANKAN TEST RUNNER (via run_command) npx vitest run, cargo test, pytest, atau go test │ ▼ 2. FILTER STACK TRACE & NOISE TERMINAL Ekstrak file yang gagal, nomor baris, nilai aktual vs ekspektasi │ ▼ 3. ANALISIS RADIUS DAMPAK (AST CHECK) Cari fungsi implementasi terkait; pisahkan logika dari file test │ ▼ 4. TERAPKAN PERBAIKAN PRESISI Perbaiki implementasi di kode produksi; DILARANG membuat mock palsu │ ▼ 5. VERIFIKASI ULANG (Maksimal 5 Iterasi) Exit code 0? ──► [YA] Selesai & Laporkan ke pengguna └──► [TIDAK] Ulangi ke Langkah 2 ``` ### Panduan Ketat Tindakan Agen 1. **Dilarang Meminta Bantuan User (Zero-Human Intervention)**: Jangan pernah berkata *"Tolong jalankan perintah ini dan beritahu saya error-nya"*. Anda memiliki tool `run_command` untuk menjalankannya sendiri, membaca output terminal, dan memperbaikinya. 2. **Kepatuhan Anti-Slop (Pilar 2)**: - Dilarang keras menonaktifkan test gagal (`test.skip`) demi memalsukan exit code 0. - Dilarang mengubah asersi menjadi bernilai selalu benar (`expect(true).toBe(true)`). - Selalu perbaiki kode implementasi produksi terlebih dahulu. 3. **Circuit Breaker 5 Siklus**: Jika kode belum berhasil diperbaiki setelah 5 kali iterasi, hentikan loop dan evaluasi ulang arsitektur logika dasar agar tidak menghabiskan konteks. ### Matriks Eksekusi Berdaulat, Efisiensi Token & Invarian | Dimensi | Mandat Berdaulat & Kontrak Deterministik | | :--- | :--- | | **Kaskade Model Frontier** | High Fast / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Gemini 4 Pro`) | | **Invarian Fallback Ketersediaan** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6`; `Grok 4.7` -> `Grok 4.6 High Fast` (Bebas gagal saat model belum tersedia/kuota penuh) | | **Protokol Hemat Token & KV-Cache** | Kunci instruksi & skema statis di prefix awal (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); kirim potongan `CONTEXT_MAP.md` (<250 token/panggilan) saat Fan-Out | | **Eksekusi SaaT CLI & MCP** | CLI: `vibes skill exec autonomous-tdd-debugger ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_critic_validate`, `vibes_self_heal`, `vibes_eval_sandbox`, `vibes_verify_invariants` | | **Invarian NFR & Anti-Slop** | Nol celah OWASP Top 10, 0 kredensial hardcoded, cakupan pengujian >= 90% pada logika domain, 0 pelanggaran Anti-Slop; kode 100% tuntas tanpa placeholder diverifikasi melalui `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` |

register_diagnostic( span = $call, message = "Use structured Pino logger (logger.info) instead of raw console.log in production modules.", severity = "error" ) } ``` ### Monorepo Override & Scoped "off" } } } } ] } ``` ### Programmatic Biome JSON Diagnostics Parser (TypeScript) Parse `biome ci --reporter=json` output for automated CI annotations and self-healing repair loops: ```typescript // location: { readonly path: { readonly file: string }; readonly span?: readonly [number, number]; }; } export interface BiomeJsonReport { readonly summary: { readonly errors: number; readonly warnings: number; }; readonly diagnostics: readonly BiomeDiagnosticEntry[]; } export function extractActionableBiomeErrors(rawJson: string): BiomeDiagnosticEntry[] { const parsed = JSON.parse(rawJson) as BiomeJsonReport; return (parsed.diagnostics ?? []).filter((d) => d.severity === 'error'); } ``` ### Blue-Ocean Synergy & Anti-Commodity Protocol - **Mandatory Blue-Ocean Pairing**: Always compose `biome-linter-formatter-expert` with `autonomous-tdd-debugger`, `autonomous-red-teamer`, `ephemeral-wasm-sandbox-executor`, `prompt-injection-firewall`, `anti-slop` so commodity boilerplate is elevated into verified, self-healing production architecture. - **Anti-Commodity Mandate**: Elevate routine tests into continuous self-healing: validate candidate patches in `vibes sandbox --verify`, fuzz OWASP/injection vectors, and gate commits via `vibes skill auto-diff`. - **Pre-Disk Gate**: Run `vibes verify-gate` and `vibes skill auto-diff --json` to inject <350-token slices and eliminate placeholder slop. ### Sovereign Execution, Token Efficiency & Invariants | Dimension | Sovereign Mandate & Deterministic Contract | | :--- | :--- | | **Frontier Model Cascade** | High Fast / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet 5.5 High`, `Gemini 4 Pro`) | | **Availability Fallback** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; console.log('Extracted Products:', productData.products); return productData.products; } finally { await stagehand.close(); } } ``` #### Recipe 2: Browser-Use with Anti-Bot Evasion (Python) ```python import asyncio from browser_use import Agent from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI from playwright.async_api import async_playwright async def run_autonomous_browser_agent(goal: str): llm = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI( model="gemini-3.8-flash", temperature=0.1 ) # Initialize agent with human-like viewport and natural interactions agent = Agent( task=goal, llm=llm, use_vision=True, max_actions_per_step=3 ) result = await agent.run(max_steps=25) print(f"Goal Completed: {result.is_done()}") return result.final_result() if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(run_autonomous_browser_agent("Search flights from CGK to HND for next month and return cheapest option")) ``` ### Execution Protocol & Guardrails - **Pre-flight**: Always inject evasion headers and randomize screen dimensions before navigating. - **Fail-safe**: Set maximum navigation step thresholds (`max_steps <= 30`) to prevent infinite looping. - **Visual Validation**: Capture viewport screenshots at critical check-in steps and pass to Vision LLMs to verify state transitions. ### Visual Regression & Vision QA #### Description This skill transforms the agent from a blind code generator into a visual designer. Instead of hoping the CSS looks correct, the agent is instructed to write a script that takes a screenshot of the newly created component, analyzes the screenshot using its own Vision AI capabilities, and iteratively tweaks the CSS until it matches the design intent perfectly. #### Trigger Conditions Activate this skill when the user says: - "Fix the CSS, the button is misaligned." - "Make it look exactly like this mockup." - "Ensure the UI is responsive on mobile screens." #### The Visual QA Loop 1. **Code:** The agent writes the HTML/CSS/React component. 2. **Serve:** The agent starts a local dev server in the background. 3. **Capture:** The agent runs a quick Playwright/Puppeteer script to take screenshots at various viewports (Mobile, Tablet, Desktop). 4. **Analyze:** The agent receives the screenshot (via the `view_file` tool on the image) and analyzes the visual hierarchy, contrast, and alignment. 5. **Correct:** The agent fixes margin, padding, or flexbox issues based on what it *saw*, not just what the code says. #### Agent Constraints (Mandatory Visual Verification) - **NO BLIND CSS GUESSING**: You are strictly prohibited from finalizing a frontend component without verifying it visually first. You MUST use a `browser_subagent` to capture a screenshot of your work. - **Pixel-Perfect Validation**: Compare the screenshot against the initial design spec or generic UI/UX best practices. `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec browser-automation-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | Workflow completion rate >= 95%, visual diff tolerance <= 0.5%, zero orphaned browser processes; 100% complete zero-placeholder output verified via `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` | --- --- ## Bahasa Indonesia ### Integrasi Orkestrasi - **Pengujian & Verifikasi E2E**: `e2e-testing-expert`, `visual-ui-auditor`, `screenshot-to-code-expert`, `accessibility-testing-expert` - **Keamanan & Red Teaming**: `autonomous-red-teamer`, `rate-limit-abuse-prevention` - **Scraping Web & Ekstraksi Data**: `web-scraper`, `deep-research-analyst` - **Frontend & Craft UI**: `senior-frontend`, `tailwind-expert`, `design-system-architect`, `modern-css-native-expert` - **Siklus Hidup & Tata Kelola**: `brainstorming`, `zero-to-prod-orchestrator`, `session-memory-manager`, `anti-slop` - **Sinergi Lintas Domain & Integrasi Swarm Subagent**: `browser-extension-mv3-pro`, `computer-use-os-agent-expert` ### Tujuan & Gambaran Umum Terapkan agen web otonom super kuat yang dapat melihat, menavigasi, dan mengeksekusi alur kerja kompleks tanpa campur tangan manusia. Menggabungkan framework otomatisasi web agentic modern (**Browser-Use**, **Stagehand v0.4+**) dengan teknik penghindaran deteksi bot tingkat tinggi (Playwright Stealth, manipulasi sidik jari perangkat, rotasi proxy residential) dan model Vision frontier (**Gemini 4 Argon / Gemini 4 Pro**, **Project Astra**, **Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Fable 5.1 Computer Use**, **OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / o3**, **Grok 4.7 High Fast**) untuk QA visual tingkat piksel. ### Kemampuan Utama 1. **Framework Eksekusi Otonom (Standar 2026)** - **Stagehand v0.4+**: Persepsi DOM berbasis bahasa alami dengan aksi semantik (`page.act()`, `page.extract()`, `page.observe()`). Menghilangkan ketergantungan pada selektor CSS/XPath yang rapuh. - **Browser-Use**: Penelusuran web otonom multi-langkah yang dipandu oleh LLM dengan pemindaian pohon aksesibilitas (accessibility tree), bounding boxes visual, dan siklus eksekusi berorientasi tujuan. 2. **Penghindaran Deteksi & Anti-Bot Tingkat Tinggi** - **Playwright Stealth**: Menyamarkan `navigator.webdriver`, mematikan skrip deteksi (Datadome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada). - **Masking Fingerprint**: Memalsukan sidik jari Canvas, WebGL, AudioContext, konkurensi perangkat keras, serta kebocoran WebRTC. - **Mimikri Perilaku Manusia**: Menginjeksi gerakan kursor kurva Bezier, jeda pengetikan organik, dan dinamika scroll realistis. 3. **QA Visual & Diffing via Vision LLM** - Teruskan screenshot viewport resolusi tinggi ke **Gemini 4 Argon/Pro Vision** (fallback: **Gemini 3.8 Flash Vision**) atau **Claude Sonnet 5.5 Vision**. - Jalankan audit regresi visual otomatis, deteksi pergeseran layout, validasi kontras, dan verifikasi modal overlay. --- ### Resep Implementasi Produksi #### Resep 1: Stagehand v0.4+ dengan Playwright Stealth (TypeScript) ```typescript import { Stagehand } from '@browserbase/stagehand'; import { z } from 'zod'; export async function jalankanAgenBelanjaOtonom(produkSasaran: string) { const stagehand = new Stagehand({ env: 'LOCAL', modelName: 'claude-sonnet-5.5-20261022', }); await stagehand.init(); Agen tidak lagi sekadar menebak CSS secara buta, melainkan mengambil *screenshot* dari halaman yang dibuatnya, melihat hasilnya, dan mengkoreksi *margin/padding* secara mandiri. #### Kondisi Pemicu - Saat pengguna meminta untuk merapikan UI yang berantakan. - Saat melakukan *cloning* desain dari gambar *mockup*. #### Panduan Singkat - **Gunakan Mata Anda (Wajib Verifikasi Visual):** Anda dilarang keras memfinalisasi atau menyelesaikan tugas frontend tanpa melihat hasilnya terlebih dahulu. Anda WAJIB mengambil *screenshot*, melihatnya menggunakan tool `view_file`, dan memverifikasi layout secara visual (*pixel-perfect*). - **Siklus Visual:** Tulis Kode ➔ Ambil Screenshot ➔ Analisis dengan *Vision* ➔ Perbaiki Tailwind/CSS ➔ Selesai. - **Jangan Menebak:** Terkadang `justify-center` tidak berfungsi karena ada pembungkus (*wrapper*) absolut. Jangan menebak-nebak di dalam kode; lihat hasil akhirnya secara visual! ### Matriks Eksekusi Berdaulat, Efisiensi Token & Invarian | Dimensi | Mandat Berdaulat & Kontrak Deterministik | | :--- | :--- | | **Kaskade Model Frontier** | High Fast / Medium / High (`Gemini 4 Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro`, `Grok 4.7 High Fast`, `Claude Sonnet/Opus 5.5`, `GPT-5.6 Sol`) | | **Invarian Fallback Ketersediaan** | `Gemini 4 (Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon/Argon/Pro)` -> `Gemini 3.8 Flash`; `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Bebas gagal saat model belum tersedia/kuota penuh) | | **Protokol Hemat Token & KV-Cache** | Kunci instruksi & skema statis di prefix awal (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); kirim potongan `CONTEXT_MAP.md` (<250 token/panggilan) saat Fan-Out | | **Eksekusi SaaT CLI & MCP** | CLI: `vibes skill exec browser-automation-expert ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **Invarian NFR & Anti-Slop** | Tingkat keberhasilan workflow >= 95%, toleransi visual diff <= 0.5%, nol proses browser terlantar; kode 100% tuntas tanpa placeholder diverifikasi melalui `node scripts/check-anti-slop.js --strict` |

skills.body: --- name: ci-cd-devops-architect description: "CI/CD deployment pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC architectures / Pipeline deploy CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, dan arsitektur IaC." author: "Roedy Rustam" version: "4.8.0" --- # CI/CD & DevOps Architect (Production Standard 2026) [English](#english) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#bahasa-indonesia) --- ## English ### Orchestration & Integration - **Upstream Pipelines**: `zero-to-prod-orchestrator` (Phase 7 CI/CD release), `brainstorming`. - **Infrastructure & Containerization**: `docker-container-expert` (multi-stage distroless images), `cloud-hosting-expert` (Vercel, Cloudflare, Railway targets). - **Security & Secrets**: `zero-trust-secret-vault` (OIDC federated auth, short-lived tokens), `production-ready-hardener` (container & SBOM security audits). - **Test Automation & Quality Gates**: `autonomous-tdd-debugger` (CI test runner execution), `e2e-testing-expert` (Playwright regression runs). - **Proactive Health & Self-Healing**: `self-healing-cloud-orchestrator` (auto-patch failed deployments), `proactive-background-watcher` (pipeline build monitoring), `feature-flag-analytics-expert` (progressive canary rollouts), `dependency-upgrade-migrator` (automated Renovate/package audits), `agentic-coding-workflow-expert` (autonomous PR & CI workflows). - **Cross-Domain Synergy & Subagent Swarm Integration**: `kubernetes-gitops-platform-expert`, `sbom-supply-chain-security-expert`, `github-actions-expert`, `biome-linter-formatter-expert` ### Description Enterprise guide for modern Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, immutable container workflows (Docker & Kubernetes 1.30+), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / OpenTofu). Covers parallelized GitHub Actions workflows with dependency caching (pnpm/bun), multi-stage non-root distroless Docker builds, Trivy container vulnerability scanning, zero-downtime rolling/canary deployments, and zero-trust secret injection via OIDC. ### Trigger Conditions - Scaffolding new GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD pipelines (Phase 7). - Writing hardened multi-stage Dockerfiles for Node.js, Bun, Go, or Rust applications. - Setting up automated PR status checks and branch protection rules. - Implementing container vulnerability scanning and SBOM generation. - Configuring Infrastructure as Code (OpenTofu/Terraform) for cloud providers. ### Production Multi-Stage Dockerfile (Node.js 24 / Distroless) ```dockerfile # syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7 # Stage 1: Dependency resolution and compilation FROM node:24-alpine AS builder WORKDIR /app # Enable pnpm via corepack RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate # Copy manifest files first to maximize layer caching COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./ RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile # Copy source code and build production bundle COPY . . RUN pnpm run build && pnpm prune --prod # Stage 2: Minimal, hardened production runtime FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs24-debian12:nonroot AS runner WORKDIR /app # Run strictly as non-root user (UID 65532 in distroless) USER nonroot # Copy only production artifacts COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/node_modules ./node_modules COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/dist ./dist COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/package.json ./package.json ENV NODE_ENV=production ENV PORT=3000 EXPOSE 3000 CMD ["dist/index.js"] ``` ### Production GitHub Actions Workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) ```yaml name: Production CI Pipeline on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: branches: [main] concurrency: group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true jobs: validate: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup pnpm uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 with: version: latest - name: Setup Node.js 24 uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 24 cache: 'pnpm' - name: Install Dependencies run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - name: Lint and Format Check (Biome) run: npx @biomejs/biome ci . - name: Type Check (TypeScript) run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit - name: Run Test Suite (Vitest) run: pnpm test security-scan: needs: validate runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Run Trivy Vulnerability Scanner uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0 with: scan-type: 'fs' ignore-unfixed: true severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH' ``` ### Keyless OIDC Cloud Deployment & Canary Smoke-Test Gate (`.github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml`) Authenticate to AWS/GCP/Azure via short-lived OIDC tokens (`id-token: write`) with zero static IAM keys stored in GitHub Secrets, followed by an automated post-deploy smoke test: ```yaml name: Keyless OIDC Production Release on: push: tags: - 'v*.*.*' permissions: id-token: write contents: read attestations: write concurrency: group: production-release cancel-in-progress: false jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest environment: name: production url: https://api.vibesplug.com steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Configure Keyless AWS OIDC Credentials uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4 with: role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-actions-prod-deployer aws-region: ap-southeast-1 - name: Build and Push Immutable Digest Image id: build_image run: | IMAGE_URI="123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/vibes-api:${GITHUB_SHA}" docker build --pull -t "${IMAGE_URI}" . docker push "${IMAGE_URI}" - name: Verify Post-Deploy Canary Health & Rollback on Failure run: | for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.vibesplug.com/api/health) if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then echo "Canary health check passed." exit 0 fi sleep 5 done echo "Canary health check failed; triggering automatic rollback." exit 1 ``` ### OpenTofu / Terraform Plan Destructive Change Gate (TypeScript) Block CI/CD auto-apply pipelines if an OpenTofu/Terraform plan (`tofu show -json tfplan`) attempts to destroy stateful production database or storage resources without manual approval: ```typescript // scripts/ci/verify-terraform-plan.ts export interface TerraformResourceChange { readonly address: string; readonly type: string; readonly change: { readonly actions: readonly ('no-op' | 'create' | 'read' | 'update' | 'delete')[]; }; } export interface TerraformPlanJson { readonly resource_changes?: readonly TerraformResourceChange[]; } const PROTECTED_STATEFUL_TYPES = new Set([ 'aws_db_instance', 'aws_rds_cluster', 'aws_s3_bucket', 'google_sql_database_instance', 'azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server', ]); export function auditTerraformPlanSafety(plan: TerraformPlanJson): { safe: boolean; blockedDeletions: string[]; } { const blockedDeletions: string[] = []; for (const rc of plan.resource_changes ?? Covers parallelized GitHub Actions workflows with dependency caching (pnpm/bun), multi-stage non-root distroless Docker builds, Trivy container vulnerability scanning, zero-downtime rolling/canary deployments, and zero-trust secret injection via OIDC. ### Trigger Conditions - Scaffolding new GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD pipelines (Phase 7). - Writing hardened multi-stage Dockerfiles for Node.js, Bun, Go, or Rust applications. - Setting up automated PR status checks and branch protection rules. - Implementing container vulnerability scanning and SBOM generation. - Configuring Infrastructure as Code (OpenTofu/Terraform) for cloud providers. ### Production Multi-Stage Dockerfile (Node.js 24 / Distroless) ```dockerfile # syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7 # Stage 1: Dependency resolution and compilation FROM node:24-alpine AS builder WORKDIR /app # Enable pnpm via corepack RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate # Copy manifest files first to maximize layer caching COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./ RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile # Copy source code and build production bundle COPY . . RUN pnpm run build && pnpm prune --prod # Stage 2: Minimal, hardened production runtime FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs24-debian12:nonroot AS runner WORKDIR /app # Run strictly as non-root user (UID 65532 in distroless) USER nonroot # Copy only production artifacts COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/node_modules ./node_modules COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/dist ./dist COPY --from=builder --chown=nonroot:nonroot /app/package.json ./package.json ENV NODE_ENV=production ENV PORT=3000 EXPOSE 3000 CMD ["dist/index.js"] ``` ### Production GitHub Actions Workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) ```yaml name: Production CI Pipeline on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: branches: [main] concurrency: group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true jobs: validate: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup pnpm uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4 with: version: latest - name: Setup Node.js 24 uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 24 cache: 'pnpm' - name: Install Dependencies run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - name: Lint and Format Check (Biome) run: npx @biomejs/biome ci . - name: Type Check (TypeScript) run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit - name: Run Test Suite (Vitest) run: pnpm test security-scan: needs: validate runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Run Trivy Vulnerability Scanner uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0 with: scan-type: 'fs' ignore-unfixed: true severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH' ``` ### Keyless OIDC Cloud Deployment & Canary Smoke-Test Gate (`.github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml`) Authenticate to AWS/GCP/Azure via short-lived OIDC tokens (`id-token: write`) with zero static IAM keys stored in GitHub Secrets, followed by an automated post-deploy smoke test: ```yaml name: Keyless OIDC Production Release on: push: tags: - 'v*.*.*' permissions: id-token: write contents: read attestations: write concurrency: group: production-release cancel-in-progress: false jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest environment: name: production url: https://api.vibesplug.com steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Configure Keyless AWS OIDC Credentials uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4 with: role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-actions-prod-deployer aws-region: ap-southeast-1 - `Claude Opus 5.5` -> `Claude Opus 4.6` (Zero unhandled missing-model errors) | | **KV-Cache & Token Protocol** | Pin static instructions & schemas at prompt prefix (`kv-cache-prefix-optimizer`); pass surgical `CONTEXT_MAP.md` slices (<250 tokens/call) during Swarm Fan-Out | | **SaaT CLI & MCP Dispatch** | CLI: `vibes skill exec ci-cd-devops-architect ` / MCP: `vibes_skill_dispatch`, `vibes_ast_query`, `vibes_compile_cache`, `vibes_optimize_budget`, `vibes_verify_gate` | | **NFR & Anti-Slop Invariants** | P99 API Gateway Latency < 85ms, OpenAPI 3.1 / TypeSpec strict schema parity, RFC 9457 Problem Details error contracts, Idempotency-Key enforcement;
